# Fixtures for `apple_strings` (Apple .strings)

Files made for whiff's tests, CC0-1.0, for a fictitious harbour (Saltmere Harbour) with fixed times; names, devices, teams and addresses (`example.org`) are fictitious. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/apple.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `Localizable.strings` | genstrings (UTF-16) from a Swift source | CC0-1.0 |
| `fr.strings` | Written by hand | CC0-1.0 |
| `Compiled.strings` | plutil -convert binary1 of `fr.strings` | CC0-1.0 |
